events.name: Storytime – Church Stretton Library – 25 September
events.description: Weekly storytime session at Church Stretton Library.
events.accessibility: Venue confirms disabled access, disabled parking and disabled toilets.

events.name: Celebrating the music of Simply Red - starring Red Mick
events.description: All-seated concert celebrating 40 years of Simply Red, performed by tribute act Red Mick. Doors 17:00; on stage 18:45.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Bongo's Bingo - Oktoberfest Special
events.description: Oktoberfest special edition of Bongo's Bingo. Doors 18:30 and last admission 20:00. Official page is 18+ only. The official page conflicts on end time (header 23:00; body 23:45), so no end time is stored here.

events.name: People's Emergency Briefing
events.description: A special screening of The People's Emergency Briefing exploring the climate and ecological emergency and what it means for communities, the environment and the future, followed by conversation and reflection.
events.accessibility: Accessible toilet listed; assistance dogs only.

events.name: The Orb
events.description: Electronic pioneers The Orb perform a rare live show at The Buttermarket, with ambient, dub and electronic material including classic tracks and extended live mixes.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: The Eminem Show - James Wythes and live band
events.description: James Wythes and a live band perform an Eminem tribute show. The official listing has a hip-hop pre-party from 18:00, with the live show starting at 19:45 and ending at 22:30 before a free after-party.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: The Greatest Musicals Sing-A-Long
events.description: Interactive musical-theatre sing-along featuring a live host, giveaways, dance-offs, lip-sync battles and songs from shows including Wicked, Grease, Mamma Mia and The Greatest Showman.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Brookside Free Football – Under 10s – 22 September
events.description: Free weekly football youth session for under-10s at Brookside Central. Tuesdays 16:00–17:00 local time. Booking requirement is not stated by the organiser.

events.name: Jet & Space Week: Spooky Storytelling – 31 October
events.description: Immersive spooky storytelling sessions at 10:45, 11:45, 13:00, 14:00 and 15:15 on 31 Oct and 1 Nov. £5 per child; adults free but must remain with their child. Recommended age 5+. The official source does not state session end times.
events.accessibility: RAF Museum classifies Spooky Storytelling as a Type C activity under its Public Events Accessibility Information.

events.name: Saturday Football Sessions – Grange Park – 19 September
events.description: Free weekly Saturday football for ages 9–16. No booking required; just turn up. This published occurrence is Saturday 19 September, 10:30–12:30 local time; organiser lists the session as weekly.

events.name: Jet & Space Week: Borrow the Moon – 26 October
events.description: Free chance to handle a real Apollo moon-rock sample and meteorites. Sessions 11:00–11:45 and 14:30–15:15 on 26–29 Oct. Limited availability; booking encouraged. Both adults and children must book when reserving. Adults must stay with children.
events.accessibility: RAF Museum classifies Borrow the Moon as a Type C activity under its Public Events Accessibility Information.

events.name: Motown & Sounds of Philadelphia Day Party ft Clive Jones
events.description: Five-hour Motown and Philadelphia Soul day party in The Cellars, headlined by Shropshire soul and Motown DJ Clive Jones.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: The Shire-ish Rovers live in The Cellars
events.description: Shrewsbury trio The Shire-ish Rovers bring Irish folk, Americana, lively classics and contemporary anthems to The Cellars. Doors 19:30, pre-party to 20:30, band on stage 20:30; official page advertises a buy-one-get-one-free ticket offer.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: There's A Monster In Your Show – 23 October
events.description: Tom Fletcher's interactive family musical for young audiences. Festival Drayton Centre confirms two performances on Friday 23 Oct at 14:00 and 16:00, each around 50 minutes. Tickets: £15 full, £12.50 under 16; online booking fee £2 per booking.

events.name: Shropshire's Mammals - Newport Branch
events.description: Talk by Shropshire Mammal Recorder Joerg Niehoegen covering the status and distribution of wild mammals in Shropshire and Telford & Wrekin, plus how the public can contribute sightings. SWT members £3, non-members £4; students and accompanied juniors free; pay on the door.
events.accessibility: Ramp down to hall from adjacent car park; accessible toilet; assistance dogs only.
events.parking_transport: Car park adjacent to the hall. Official page asks visitors not to park at the Village Hall opposite.

events.name: Shropshire Rivers Hub Conference
events.description: The Shropshire Rivers Hub conference brings together river enthusiasts, land and water managers, experts and organisations to explore the future of Shropshire's rivers and waterways. Official listing offers in-person and online participation.

events.name: Rooted in Recovery Exhibition
events.description: Art, nature and lived experience come together in an exhibition exploring recovery, resilience and connection. The work was created through a nature-based art psychotherapy programme delivered by an NHS Early Intervention in Psychosis Service. Official listing runs 15 September to 9 November and shows 10:00–16:00; visitors should use museum opening information for individual days.

events.name: Brookside Free Football – Over 10s – 22 September
events.description: Free youth football at Brookside Central for over-10s. Tuesdays 17:00–18:00 local time. Booking requirement is not stated by the organiser.

events.name: Wild in the Woods – Fordhall Organic Farm – 29 October
events.description: A day of magical adventure in the woods for ages 6 to 13.

events.name: I'm Still Standing - Young Elton & Live Band
events.description: Young Elton and live band celebrate the music of Elton John. Doors 18:00, 70s/80s pre-party until 19:45, Young Elton on stage from 19:45; official event runs to 22:00 before an after-party.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult

events.name: Little Wytheford Farm Pumpkin Patch – 9 October
events.description: Pumpkin patch at Little Wytheford Farm. Admission is free; pumpkins typically cost £2–£5 depending on size. Dogs are welcome on leads.

events.name: Jet & Space Week: Planetarium – 28 October
events.description: Planetarium shows at 10:30, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00 and 15:00 each day from 28–30 Oct. Tickets £6.50 for both adults and children; booking highly encouraged. Recommended age 6+. The official source does not state a session end time, so none is added here.
events.accessibility: RAF Museum classifies the Space Odyssey Planetarium as a Type C activity under its Public Events Accessibility Information.

events.name: Apley’s Haunted Harvest – Pick a Pumpkin – 10 October
events.description: Pick your own pumpkin from Apley’s home-grown pumpkin field. Well-behaved dogs on leads are permitted on the pumpkin field.

events.name: Jet & Space Week: Lego Balloon Jets – 26 October
events.description: Free drop-in Lego Balloon Jets during RAF Museum Midlands Jet & Space Week. First session 26 Oct 10:30–12:30; also 13:30–15:30 that day. The same two time slots repeat on 28 and 30 Oct. Adults must stay with children.
events.accessibility: RAF Museum classifies Lego Balloon Jets as a Type B activity under its Public Events Accessibility Information.

events.name: Dom Joly - Trigger Happy TV - the 25th Anniversary Tour
events.description: Dom Joly marks 25 years of Trigger Happy TV with a live anniversary tour featuring iconic characters, sketches and behind-the-scenes stories. Totally seated event. VIP doors 18:00, general admission 18:30, on stage 19:30.
events.age_guidance: Under 18s must be accompanied by an adult
